settings.title: What’s a Private Storefront?
settings.subtitle: A private storefront is a secure, invite-only shop built for your group—approved members log in, shop approved products, and reorder anytime.
settings.problem_text: Coordinating group orders is a nightmare of spreadsheets, loose cash, and wrong sizes. Our platform removes you from the transaction entirely.
settings.access_text: Whether you need military-grade exclusivity or casual group sharing, we give you the keys.
